Class ClassName

java.lang.Object
com.google.errorprone.ClassName
@Immutable public final class ClassName extends Object
Encapsulates a qualified class name and caches its resolved javac Symbol.ClassSymbol, Type, and Name across a compilation.

  • Method Details

    • of

      public static ClassName of(String name)
      Constructs a ClassName from a qualified canonical or binary class name (e.g. "java.util.List", "java.util.Map.Entry", or "java.util.Map$Entry").
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if name is empty, ends with '.', is primitive/void, is an array type ("[...]"), or is parameterized ("<...>")
